system.description: In response to an attack made by an ally within 30ft of you that is some number on the die away from a critical hit, you may expend any number of Spell Slots. For each Spell Slot expended, increase the critical range of your ally by one (e.g., if an ally rolls a nat18, and they only critically hit on a 20, you may expend two spell slots to make the attack critically hit).

meta.prerequisite: Research: You are a Fatebound with the Targeted Foe ability
